name: LLM latent-space culturally bound concept experiments

mentions.name: LLM latent-space culturally bound concept experiments
mentions.description: An experimental project using LLMs to investigate whether the structure of latent space can be used to identify culturally bound concepts, such as "fan death", with runs of Qwen optimized on a local GPU to test theories.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been vibe coding with LLMs to see if the structure of latent space could be used to identify culturally bound concepts, like "fan death" and having it optimize runs of Qwen on my local GPU to test theories.
